# (.github/workflows/promote.yml). One path or glob per line; a directory removes everything
# under it. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
#
# Rule: `main` holds what people who use or contribute to the app need. Agent and maintainer
# working files stay on `edge`. Never list anything the build, the tests, CI or the Docker
# image needs.
